# Generated by gen_p07.py - do not edit by hand.
source React 19.3.1 on jsdom 30.1.3 (tools/oracle); ops lines from a model of the matching rules in tools/gen_p07.py
seed 1
compare records node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value title=value ops=create,remove dump=n
explain ops=R9
requirement R1 Rendering a list again with the same keys in the same order keeps every node and writes the changed props and text into it
requirement R2 A new keyed child is built and placed where the new list has it: at the front, in the middle or at the end
requirement R3 A child whose key is still in the list keeps its node (and everything below it) while others are added and removed around it
requirement R4 A child whose key is missing from the new list is removed, that child only, wherever it stood
requirement R5 A new key, or the same key on a different tag, gives a new node in the old child's place
requirement R6 An input keeps what was typed into it for as long as its key stays in the list, and a new input starts empty
requirement R7 A key is an exact string: the empty string is a key, and "0", "00", "1" and "01" are different keys
requirement R8 Children without a key match by position, and a keyed child never matches an unkeyed one
requirement R9 `ops create remove` counts a node for every element and text node of a new child and one removal for every removed child
requirement E2E Whole sessions on keyed lists
